gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the batteries in all four recommended cameras (eufy SoloCam S340, Reolink Argus Eco Ultra, Reolink Argus 4 Pro, Tapo C660 Kit) stop accepting charge from the solar panel below 32°F (0°C), even though their makers rate them to keep running down to 14°F or -4°F. Through a freezing spell the panel adds nothing and the camera runs only on what is left in its battery.
standout_why: I opened the cited rottenwifi.com page (2026-08-09), the cited reolink.com buying guide (2026-10-28) and homegearlab.org (2026-10-12). Reolink's guide says only that winter sun is weaker and cold shortens runtime. It never gives a charging temperature range. homegearlab lists operating ranges only (S340 and Ring at -4°F to 122°F), which suggests the cameras charge at those temperatures too. rottenwifi says cold 'increases consumption'. Its only mention of a 32°F limit is an Amazon listing bullet it reproduces for the Tapo SolarCam C402, which is not one of ChatGPT's picks. None of the three ties the cutoff to the S340, the Argus models or the C660. None separates the operating range from the charging range, and none names Reolink's Solar Panel 2S, which powers the camera below freezing. That partial C402 mention is why this scores 2 and not 3. pvrblog.com and solargenadvisor.com would not load (SSL certificate error), so I could not check them.
decides: For a shopper where winter days stay below freezing, no panel-and-camera pair from ChatGPT's list keeps charging. The battery reserve becomes the deciding spec: Argus 4 Pro 5,000 mAh, Argus Eco Ultra 21.6 Wh, S340 and C660 not stated on the maker pages I opened. The only freeze workaround a maker documents is Reolink's Solar Panel 2S. Its own 5,900 mAh battery powers the camera between 0°C and -20°C, but Reolink's compatibility line excludes 'Reolink Argus', so 2S support for the Argus 4 Pro and Eco Ultra is unresolved. In mild climates the finding confirms ChatGPT's picks. In cold climates it argues for the biggest battery, or for a wired or PoE camera. The C660's 2.5 W and the S340's 2.2 W panels also recover less in short winter days than Reolink's 6 W Solar Panel 2.
candidates: Reolink Argus Eco Ultra + Solar Panel

findings.product: Reolink Argus 4 Pro / Argus Eco Ultra (with Solar Panel, Solar Panel 2 or Solar Panel 3)
findings.label: Solar charging temperature range
findings.source_title: Reolink Solar Panels Not Working (Reolink Support)
findings.note: Quote: 'If you connect the Reolink Solar Panel (3W)/Solar Panel 2 (6W)/Solar Panel 3 (12W) to your camera, the charging temperature is 0°C to 45°C (32°F to 113°F). Charging may temporarily stop when the current temperature is below 0°C to protect the lithium battery.' The article covers Reolink battery cameras 'except Reolink Argus, Keen, and Reolink Doorbell (Battery)'.

findings.label: Below-freezing behaviour
findings.value: Built-in 5,900 mAh (42.48 Wh) battery powers the camera directly from 0°C to -20°C (-4°F); the panel recharges its own battery from -10°C (14°F) to 58°C; 6 W panel
findings.source_title: Introduction to Reolink Solar Panel 2S (Reolink Support)
findings.note: Quote: between 0°C and -20°C the built-in battery will 'directly power the camera instead of charging it', so the camera's battery level stays unchanged in the app. Compatibility as written: 'All Reolink battery-powered cameras except Reolink Argus, Keen, and Reolink Doorbell (Battery)'. The page does not say whether that exclusion covers the Argus 4 Pro and Argus Eco Ultra.

findings.note: The page gives no charging temperature. The camera keeps operating down to 14°F, but per the support article above it stops charging below 32°F.

unsourced: An S340-specific charging temperature: the eufy US product page returned 404 and the Irish page lists only the operating range. The eufy 32°F figure comes from a general eufy support article.
Battery capacity for the eufy S340 and Tapo C660 Kit: neither maker page I opened states one (the Tapo spec page says only 'Built-in Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery').

Whether Reolink Solar Panel 2S works with the Argus 4 Pro or Argus Eco Ultra: the US product page returned 404, the support article excludes 'Reolink Argus' without listing models, and Reolink's 'Which Cameras Can Work with Reolink Solar Panel' article lists both cameras only under Solar Panel (3W).
A named reviewer's measured winter (sub-freezing) battery drain for any of the four candidates: not searched within the tool budget.
